changes_required — 5 findings: P0 0, P1 3, P2 1, P3 1.
The proposed DP composition reconciles launch times after first attention, allowing work to overlap another lane’s host stall.
The real-workload forward-end hook is absent, and the gap estimator neither isolates host time nor provides controls for all required buckets.
Native reset synchronization and local once-only overhead accounting are supported. Validation used source checks and retained traces; no unprofiled GPU probe or full simulator regression ran.
